e.title: WHO 全球卫生观测站（GHO）与 WHO 死亡率数据库：带置信区间的官方健康数据 API
e.title_en: WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO) and WHO Mortality Database: official health data with a working API and confidence intervals
e.title_hk: WHO 全球衛生觀測站（GHO）與 WHO 死亡率數據庫：帶置信區間的官方健康數據 API
e.summary: 世界卫生组织数据门户：GHO 指标库可经 OData API 取数（实测返回含上下界的期望寿命值），另有 WHO 死亡率数据库
e.summary_en: The World Health Organization’s data portal: the GHO indicator catalogue is queryable through a working OData API (a life-expectancy value with bounds was retrieved live), plus the WHO Mortality Database
e.summary_hk: 世界衛生組織數據門戶：GHO 指標庫可經 OData API 取數（實測返回含上下界的期望壽命值），另有 WHO 死亡率數據庫
e.body:
**WHO 全球卫生观测站（GHO）** 是世界卫生组织的**官方健康数据门户**，也是本轮的**死亡率/发病率数据源轴**的第一条——实测池内 **WHO、CDC、Eurostat、IHME/GBD 相关条目全部为 0**，即**「官方死因与疾病负担数据源」这一整层此前是空白**（池内只有 [[human-mortality-db]] 一系人口死亡率库与其 R/Julia 客户端）。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：GHO 门户 `/data/gho` HTTP 200（147.7KB）；**WHO 死亡率数据库页 `/data/data-collection-tools/who-mortality-database` HTTP 200（104.4KB）**；⭐ **最关键的是其数据接口实测可用**——`https://ghoapi.azureedge.net/api/Indicator` 返回 **200、`application/json`、414.7KB**，内含 `@odata.context`（OData 服务）与真实指标目录（如 `ABORTION_ADMISSIONS`、`Adult_curr_cig_smoking` 等，含 `IndicatorCode`/`IndicatorName`/`Language` 字段）；进一步实测**具体指标数据端点** `…/api/WHOSIS_000001`（期望寿命），返回记录包含 **空间维度类型 `COUNTRY`、`SpatialDim: "SOM"`（索马里）、`ParentLocation: "Eastern Mediterranean"`、性别维度 `Dim1: "SEX_MLE"`、`TimeDim: 2008`，以及带上下界的值 `Value: "48.0 [46.7-49.6]"`、`NumericValue: 48.0375`、`Low: 46.7168`、`High: 49.6285`**，并附数据时间戳——**即这是一个可直接取数、且自带置信区间字段的官方 API**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「疾病与死因」这一层**——人寿与健康险定价、长寿风险分析与准备金评估都需要**分死因、分性别、分国家人群**的数据，而池内此前只有**总人口死亡率库**（[[human-mortality-db]]、[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[hmd-jl]]）与**建模包**（[[mortalitylaws]]、[[pymort]]、[[apc-r]]、[[multipopulation-mortality-models]]）；**WHO 死亡率数据库与 GHO 指标库填的正是「死因构成、期望寿命、健康指标」这一层**，可与 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[comorbidity]]、[[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]] 并读。**② API 自带 `Low`/`High` 字段**——这在精算上很实用：**不确定性区间可以直接进入敏感性分析**，比只给点估计的库省一步；**③ OData 形态**也意味着可用通用客户端或 `$filter/$top` 查询参数取数。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**门户页、死亡率数据库页、指标目录端点与一个具体指标数据端点（含完整返回结构）**，**但未系统检索指标全集、未做国别批量取数，也未与各国官方统计交叉核对**；**②** WHO 数据有**已知的报告时滞与口径差异**（不同国家上报质量不一），**本词条不评价其数据质量**；**③** OData 接口需**支持 OData 的客户端或手工构造查询**，**并非即插即用的 DataFrame**；**④** WHO Mortality Database 的**下载方式与许可条款本次未逐项核实**。**核实说明**：GHO 门户（147.7KB）、WHO 死亡率数据库页（104.4KB）、`/api/Indicator`（414.7KB JSON）、`/api/WHOSIS_000001`（含 SOM 2008 期望寿命记录的完整返回）均实测；**未做批量取数或交叉核对**。
e.body_en:
The **WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO)** is the World Health Organization’s **official health data portal**, and the first entry in this round’s **mortality and morbidity data source axis** — a measured search found **zero entries for WHO, CDC, Eurostat or IHME/GBD**, meaning **the entire layer of "official cause-of-death and disease-burden data" was missing** (the corpus held only the [[human-mortality-db]] population-mortality family and its R/Julia clients).

Verifiable details (**all measured**): the GHO portal `/data/gho` returned HTTP 200 (147.7KB); the **WHO Mortality Database page `/data/data-collection-tools/who-mortality-database`** returned HTTP 200 (104.4KB); ⭐ **most importantly, its data interface is measurably live** — `https://ghoapi.azureedge.net/api/Indicator` returned **200, `application/json`, 414.7KB** containing `@odata.context` (an OData service) and a real indicator catalogue (`IndicatorCode`, `IndicatorName`, `Language`, e.g. `ABORTION_ADMISSIONS`, `Adult_curr_cig_smoking`). A **specific data endpoint was then exercised**: `…/api/WHOSIS_000001` (life expectancy) returned a record with **spatial dimension type `COUNTRY`, `SpatialDim: "SOM"` (Somalia), `ParentLocation: "Eastern Mediterranean"`, sex dimension `Dim1: "SEX_MLE"`, `TimeDim: 2008`, and a value carrying bounds — `Value: "48.0 [46.7-49.6]"`, `NumericValue: 48.0375`, `Low: 46.7168`, `High: 49.6285`** — plus a data timestamp. **In other words, this is an official API that returns data directly and carries confidence-interval fields.**

For RIAA: **① it adds the "disease and cause of death" layer** — life and health insurance pricing, longevity analysis and reserving all need **cause-, sex- and country-specific population data**, and the corpus previously held only **total-population mortality databases** ([[human-mortality-db]], [[hmdhfdplus]], [[hmd-jl]]) and **modelling packages** ([[mortalitylaws]], [[pymort]], [[apc-r]], [[multipopulation-mortality-models]]); the WHO Mortality Database and GHO indicator catalogue supply exactly **that layer of cause composition, life expectancy and health indicators**, readable with [[lifeinsurer]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]], [[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]], [[comorbidity]] and [[soa-cc230-climate-mortality]]. **② The API carries `Low`/`High` fields** — practically useful actuarially, because **uncertainty bounds can feed sensitivity analysis directly**, saving a step relative to point-estimate-only sources; **③ the OData form** also means generic clients or `$filter`/`$top` query parameters can be used.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the portal page, the mortality database page, the indicator catalogue endpoint and one specific data endpoint (with its full return structure)**, **but did not systematically enumerate indicators, pull country batches, or cross-check against national statistics**; **②** WHO data has **known reporting lags and definitional differences across countries**, and **this entry does not assess its data quality**; **③** the OData interface requires **an OData-capable client or hand-built queries** and is **not a ready-made DataFrame**; **④** the **download methods and licensing terms** of the WHO Mortality Database **were not verified item by item**. **Verification note**: the GHO portal (147.7KB), the WHO Mortality Database page (104.4KB), `/api/Indicator` (414.7KB JSON) and `/api/WHOSIS_000001` (including the full Somalia-2008 life-expectancy record) were all measured; **no batch extraction or cross-check was performed**.
e.body_hk:
**WHO 全球衛生觀測站（GHO）** 是世界衛生組織的**官方健康數據門戶**，也是本輪**死亡率／發病率數據源軸**的第一條——實測池內 **WHO、CDC、Eurostat、IHME/GBD 相關條目全部為 0**，即**「官方死因與疾病負擔數據源」這一整層此前空白**。

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：GHO 門戶 HTTP 200（147.7KB）；**WHO 死亡率數據庫頁 HTTP 200（104.4KB）**；⭐ **最關鍵的是其數據接口實測可用**——`/api/Indicator` 返回 **200、`application/json`、414.7KB**，含 `@odata.context`（OData 服務）與真實指標目錄；進一步實測**具體指標端點** `/api/WHOSIS_000001`（期望壽命），返回記錄含 **空間維度 `COUNTRY`、`SpatialDim: "SOM"`（索馬里）、`ParentLocation: "Eastern Mediterranean"`、性別維度 `Dim1: "SEX_MLE"`、`TimeDim: 2008`，以及帶上下界的值 `Value: "48.0 [46.7-49.6]"`、`Low: 46.7168`、`High: 49.6285`**——**即這是可直接取數、且自帶置信區間欄位的官方 API**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「疾病與死因」這一層**——池內此前只有**總人口死亡率庫**（[[human-mortality-db]]、[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[hmd-jl]]）與**建模包**（[[mortalitylaws]]、[[pymort]]、[[apc-r]]）；WHO 填的正是**死因構成、期望壽命、健康指標**這一層，可與 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[comorbidity]] 並讀；**② API 自帶 `Low`/`High` 欄位**——**不確定性區間可直接進入敏感性分析**；**③ OData 形態**意味著可用通用客戶端或 `$filter/$top` 取數。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**門戶頁、死亡率數據庫頁、指標目錄端點與一個具體指標數據端點**，**但未系統檢索指標全集、未做批量取數、未與各國官方統計交叉核對**；**②** WHO 數據有**已知報告時滯與口徑差異**，**本詞條不評價其數據質量**；**③** OData 接口**並非即插即用的 DataFrame**；**④** 死亡率數據庫的**下載方式與許可條款未逐項核實**。**核實說明**：四項均實測；**未做批量取數或交叉核對**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（GHO 门户 /data/gho 147.7KB；WHO 死亡率数据库页 104.4KB）+ ★API 实测：https://ghoapi.azureedge.net/api/Indicator 返回 200 / application/json / 414.7KB，含 @odata.context 与真实指标目录（ABORTION_ADMISSIONS、Adult_curr_cig_smoking 等，字段 IndicatorCode/IndicatorName/Language）；★具体指标数据端点实测：/api/WHOSIS_000001 返回含 SpatialDimType=COUNTRY、SpatialDim=SOM、ParentLocation=Eastern Mediterranean、Dim1=SEX_MLE、TimeDim=2008、Value="48.0 [46.7-49.6]"、NumericValue=48.0375、Low=46.7168、High=49.6285 及 Date 时间戳；未做批量取数或交叉核对
